templates.label: Google Sheets
templates.reads: The rows of one sheet: a column metric (the Metric's slug), a column value, and optionally a column period (the period's first day).
templates.needs: A Google account that can read the sheet.

templates.label: Microsoft Excel
templates.reads: The rows of one Excel table in a workbook on OneDrive or SharePoint: a column metric (the Metric's slug), a column value, and optionally a column period (the period's first day, a date cell).
templates.needs: A Microsoft account that can read the workbook, and an app registration for n8n.

templates.label: Stripe
templates.reads: Your subscriptions, read only: monthly recurring revenue, customers with a subscription and customers who cancelled, for the month that has just ended.
templates.needs: A Stripe restricted key that can read subscriptions and nothing else.

templates.label: HubSpot
templates.reads: Two counts, read only: deals won and new contacts, for the month that has just ended.
templates.needs: A HubSpot private app token with read access to deals and contacts.

templates.label: BigQuery
templates.reads: The rows of a query you write in BigQuery, read only: each row has a metric (the Metric's slug), a value and the period's first day. Runs once a month, for the month that has just ended.
templates.needs: A Google Cloud project and a service account (or login) that may run queries and read the tables the query names, and nothing more.

templates.label: Snowflake
templates.reads: The rows of a query you write in Snowflake, read only: each row has a metric (the Metric's slug), a value and the period's first day. Runs once a month, for the month that has just ended.
templates.needs: A Snowflake user with a role that may run queries on a warehouse and read the tables the query names, and nothing more.

templates.label: HubSpot forecast
templates.reads: Deal amounts, read only: closed this quarter and pipeline value, and if you like commit and best case, for the week that has just ended, for the team and per salesperson.
templates.needs: A HubSpot service key or private app token that can read deals and nothing else.

templates.label: Salesforce forecast
templates.reads: Opportunity totals, read only: closed this quarter and pipeline value, and if you like commit and best case, for the week that has just ended, for the team and per salesperson.
templates.needs: A Salesforce user that may read all opportunities and change nothing, and a connected app for n8n.

templates.label: Pipedrive forecast
templates.reads: Deal values, read only: closed this quarter and pipeline value for the week that has just ended, for the team and per salesperson. Pipedrive has no forecast category, so no commit or best case.
templates.needs: The API token of a Pipedrive user who sees all deals. Pipedrive cannot limit a token to reading; the workflow only reads.
